headline: Main target: a specific smooth hypersurface in a family where the Hodge conjecture is open, with a class proved Hodge and no known algebraic cycle ("a Hodge class not known to be algebraic"). No candidate so far. One open lead on cubic tenfolds is under study; it is NOT a candidate and its evidence is mod p.

active.title: Cubic tenfold lead (two 5-planes meeting in a P^2)
active.state: OPEN lead, NOT a candidate; evidence mod p, finite order
active.summary: At the Fermat cubic tenfold with Movasati's pair of 5-planes, first-order directions for [P1] - [P2] (lambda = -1) extend as formal arcs: one to order 12 at two primes, 48/48 new ones to order 9, none obstructed; lambda = 2 controls are obstructed at order 6 (120/120; exact certificate at three directions), and 26 other coefficients are obstructed at order 6. lambda = -1 is not the special coefficient of the general rule (lambda_0 = +1, checked). Finite-order arcs are evidence, not a proof that a new component exists, and no specific smooth member off the cone locus is known. A pre-registered test at points without the Fermat symmetry (mod p, blind-checked) found the same pattern: lambda = -1 directions extend to order 6-8 while lambda = 2 is obstructed at order 6, so the survival is not an artefact of that symmetry; at C_18 points the extra direction is unobstructed at order 2 (mod p, blind-checked) and at order 3 (mod p, not yet blind-checked). This makes the lead stronger; it remains an open lead, NOT a candidate.

active.title: Three or more cycles: special coefficients
active.state: first-order conic confirmed; second-order obstruction confirmed (mod p); next steps open
active.summary: On an explicit quartic sixfold with three 3-planes in one P^4, the tangent space of the Hodge locus jumps on the six pairwise lines and on a conic determined by a cross-ratio of four points. Exact over QQ at a conic point. At second order the extra direction is obstructed (blind check, two primes): near such points the Hodge locus is no bigger than the locus where the planes persist. Next: non-linear configurations, sextic fourfolds, an exact second-order certificate.

recent.what: Prior work credited: rStation papers #5 (u/lelong_ridge, 18 Oct 2026; Movasati's Conjecture 1 fails for cubic sixfolds and eightfolds; Theorem D at n = 10) and #11 (17 Oct 2026; Hodge conjecture for Thom-Sebastiani cubic tenfolds) added to the registry. The tenfold lead addresses #5's open question (a component above slice dimension 155): evidence suggests yes, for lambda = -1 only (mod p, finite order); still an open lead, NOT a candidate.

Tenfold lead: at C_18 points the extra Hodge-tangent direction is unobstructed at order 2 (blind check agrees) and at order 3 (4/4, mod p; controls pass). Lead stronger; still an open lead, NOT a candidate.

Tenfold lead: pre-registered symmetry test at two split points without the swap symmetry: lambda = -1 extends (order 6: 16/16, order 8: 8/8), lambda = 2 obstructed at order 6 (mod p, two primes; blind check agrees). Second order at C_18 points: unobstructed (mod p). Lead stronger; still open, NOT a candidate.

Tenfold lead: lambda_0 = +1 confirmed for two 5-planes meeting in a P^2 (first-order excess only at lambda_0 at a general point; at every coefficient at the Fermat point; mod p). Registry D-TENFOLD-LAMBDA0-CHECK.

Tenfold lead, overnight cloud runs (mod p, checker re-run): lambda = -1 generic directions extend (one to order 12 at two primes; 48/48 to order 9; more to order 10); lambda = 2 controls 120/120 obstructed at order 6. Still an open lead, not a candidate. Dossier: leads/TENFOLD_CONE_LEAD_DOSSIER.md.
Sextic fourfolds: jump-divisor scans (472 + 106 types, mod p) found no surviving excess at general points (all die or singular).

Cubic sixfolds set aside as a target: the Hodge conjecture is known for every smooth cubic sixfold (Steenbrink, via Albano-Collino). Delsarte members of the open families checked: none gives a candidate.
Second-order checker corrected: outside the range with condition (S) false it now says NOT DETERMINED instead of ALL SURVIVE (Movasati's 2019 tables were right; 4 cases recomputed independently).
Second order on the conic: the extra direction is obstructed (blind check, two primes). First-order value exact over QQ; conic explained by a cross-ratio.
Blind check confirmed the conic of special coefficients (first order; exact at named points, mod p for the conic).
Three-cycle target: candidate conic of special coefficients found (exact at one instance); blind check started.

Survey of related work: one-cycle results of Kloosterman (arXiv:2104.14845) and Dan noted; Movasati's 2019 Fermat-surface tables cross-checked (1758 records agree at first order; 42 records differ at second order outside the range, unresolved).
Software package HodgeLociCI 0.1.0 and this discoveries registry published; one blind install check, all 28 findings fixed.
Discovery round closed: explicit families for coefficient -1 (sums of two determinants) and 1 (Pfaffians) on cubic sixfolds; no unexplained piece found for fake linear cycles on quartic sixfolds.
